sentences.text:
In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of  the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973/Section 482 of the  Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, filed in connection  with Ultadanga Police Station Case No. 182 of 2023 dated  15.12.2023 under Sections 420/506/467/468/471/120B of the  IPC.
 And  In the matter of: Ashok Kumar Goenka and another  .... petitioners  Mr. Pinak Kumar Mitra,
 Ms. Subhanwita Ghosh  ....for the petitioners  Mr. Saryati Datta,
 Mr. Arka Chakraborty  ....for the State  1.
The case diary is incomplete.
The allegation is that M/s Sunidhi Developers Pvt. Ltd. has failed to pay a sum of Rs.15 lakhs in terms of the arbitral award.
Prima facie, it appears to be a civil dispute.

However, we feel that the de facto complainant is required to be heard.
2.
A complete case diary should be produced.
3. Accordingly, we direct the State to produce scanned copies of the case diary on the adjourned date.
4. The matter shall next be listed on 06th November, 2024.
5. Till such time, no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioners.
